facts.statement: Diandongosaurus was first named by Qing-Hua Shang, Xiao-Chun Wu, and Chun Li in 2011.
facts.quote: It was first named by Qing-Hua Shang, Xiao-Chun Wu, Chun Li in 2011

facts.statement: Diandongosaurus lived during the lower Middle Triassic (Anisian age) in Yunnan Province, southwestern China.
facts.quote: Diandongosaurus is an extinct genus of eosauropterygian known from the lower Middle Triassic (Anisian age) of Yunnan Province, southwestern China

facts.statement: The genus is known from the holotype specimen IVPP V 17761, which is a complete and articulated skeleton including the skull.
facts.quote: It is known from the holotype IVPP V 17761, a complete and articulated skeleton with skull

facts.statement: The fossils were discovered in the middle Triassic Lagerstätte of the Guanling Formation.
facts.quote: which was found in the middle Triassic Lagerstätte of the Guanling Formation

facts.statement: A referred specimen indicates that Diandongosaurus reached a total body length of 34 cm.
facts.quote: A referred specimen suggests a total body length of 34 cm

facts.statement: Diandongosaurus belongs to the parent group Eosauropterygia.
Diandongosaurus is classified within the class Reptilia.

rejected.statement: The genus Diandongosaurus was formally described by Shang et al. in 2011.
